_comment: RU routing pipeline - Xray server example. Placeholder tokens {{VERSION}} and {{CDN_BASE}} are substituted at build time by ru_routing.render.render_examples. node-example is a documented placeholder outbound tag: replace its address/credentials with a real inter-node deployment before use.
_default_outbound_comment: 5. Unmatched traffic to DIRECT. Xray uses the first entry of 'outbounds' as the default when no routing rule matches, so 'direct' is declared first here: the server dataset runs on the egress node itself, so a conservative PROXY-style default would misroute the node's own general traffic. Exceptions are handled by the explicit BLOCK categories and named service outbounds below.

outbounds._comment: Optional additional upstream outbound for this deployment; not used by the default server policy below.

PLACEHOLDER outbound tag for deployment-specific inter-node routing. Replace address/credentials with a real node address/credentials before deployment. Used below to route a small representative subset of service categories.

rules._comment: 1. Private/local domains and IP traffic to DIRECT via the generated private geosite and Xray's built-in geoip:private.
2. BitTorrent protocol traffic to BLOCK. This is Xray's native protocol-detection rule (protocol sniffing), not a domain/IP list.
3. spy and ads categories to BLOCK (domains). Both are sourced from runetfreedom/russia-v2ray-rules-dat (domain-only; no CIDR source), so there is no corresponding IP rule.
4. Example service categories (google, youtube) routed to the node-example placeholder inter-node outbound. Replace node-example before deployment.
Trusted RU and Russia-only traffic to DIRECT, matching the shared lite/server policy base.
Reviewed RU GeoIP CIDRs to DIRECT.
